title: Failed
description: On stderr: one dump failed (no temporary file could be made, pg_dump failed, or the dump could not be put in place). Nothing was deleted and no file left behind. `once` then exits 1; the schedule tries again.

kind.description: The program (or, for the bridge, the message type) that printed the line.

run.description: One id per invocation (for the bridge, per process), on every line it prints: a random (version 4) UUID.

message.description: Why, with pg_dump's own message. The password is scrubbed from it.
